fields.System.Title: RPL-104 — Report pick locations with no rule
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want a list of pick faces that will never replenish, so
that they do not run dry silently.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given the report, then it lists every pick location holding stock with no active
  • replenishment rule.
  • - Given the report, then it also lists rules that fail current validation.
  • - Given a pick location deliberately excluded from replenishment, then it can be marked
  • as such and suppressed from the report.
  • - Given the report, then it runs weekly and its output reaches a person.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment, masterdata |
| Tables | replen_rule, location, stock_balance |
| Risks | Pick faces with no rule running dry ([doc 09 §7.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration |
